indirect_details: Primary: his own official Yashoda Hospitals doctor page for the Secunderabad neuro-surgery unit, which carries the hospital's per-doctor appointment request - https://www.yashodahospitals.com/doctor/secunderabad/neuro-surgery/dr-ayyadurai-r/ . Secondary: an independent practice website that presents him and Dr. Kancherla Krishna Tej Reddy as neurosurgeons in Secunderabad has its own booking page - https://www.neuro-surgeons.com/appointment.html . He is also reachable professionally via his own LinkedIn profile, which lists Yashoda Hospitals as his employer: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-ayyadurai-rethnathankom-0708803b/
verified_role: Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon, Department of Neuro Surgery, Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, Hyderabad (previously Associate Professor, Department of Neurosurgery, Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, Kochi, 2005-2024; founder of the Amrita Centre for Neuro-Endoscopy)
verified_experience: Official Yashoda profile states he has been in the field of neurosurgery since 1998; MBBS from Shri B M Patil Medical College, Karnataka (1997) and DNB Neurosurgery from Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, Kerala (2010). The input row's '20 Years' figure was NOT seen verbatim in any search output - treat it as the hospital list-page figure, not something confirmed here.
hni_signals: Senior Consultant grade (the hospital's own wording), i.e. above plain Consultant. Reported experience of roughly 5,000 brain tumour surgeries including skull base tumours, pituitary adenomas, craniopharyngiomas, vestibular schwannomas, meningiomas, gliomas and brain metastases. Founded the Amrita Centre for Neuro-Endoscopy and was faculty for the Cadaver Skull Base Endoscopy Workshop - i.e. a teaching/academic track record and an Associate Professor title at Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences, Kochi (2005-2024), preceded by neurosurgery residency at Apollo Superspeciality Hospital, Chennai (to 2005). Pioneered a new endoport technique using the ROSA neuro robotic system and authors Yashoda's public-facing content on robotic neurosurgery. Named on an independent two-doctor practice website marketing him as a top Secunderabad neurosurgeon, and listed on Amrita's Advanced Centre for Robotic Surgery faculty. Recruited across state lines (Kerala to Telangana) in 2024 to head-level robotic/endoscopic neurosurgery work.
